title: Untransported tensor coherence on the specified older raw rational stages
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an arbitrary scheme $Y$, without a structure map to $k$. Let $E,L,M,N$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, equipped with $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra homomorphisms $i:E\to L$, $j:L\to M$, $h:M\to N$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For each such field $F$, let $\mathcal A_F^{\mathrm{old}}$ be exactly $\mathrm{boundedConstructibleDerivedCompleteIntegralCategory}(D,\ell,\ell\ne p,F,Y)$: the full category of derived-complete integral complexes whose reductions by the specified $\mathrm{integralDerivedReduction}$ are finite-torsion constructible in a single finite cohomological interval independent of the positive reduction level [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Use its raw Hom scalar localization $C_F^{\mathrm{old}}=\mathcal A_F^{\mathrm{old}}[1/\varpi_F]=\mathrm{rationalConstructibleCategory}(D,\ell,\ell\ne p,F,Y)$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Write $T_i=\mathrm{rationalScalarExtension}(D,\ell,\ell\ne p,E,Y,L,i)$, and similarly for every composite map. Let
$$a_{j,i}:T_jT_i\xrightarrow{\sim}T_{j\circ i}$$
be precisely $\mathrm{rationalConstructibleScalarComp}$, the canonical tensor associator of [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition] on this older presentation, before transport to any separately named composite coefficient map. Then for every $K\in C_E^{\mathrm{old}}$,
$$T_h(a_{j,i,K})\,;\,a_{h,j\circ i,K}
=a_{h,j,T_iK}\,;\,a_{h\circ j,i,K},$$
where semicolons compose in the written order, and the two triple composite coefficient maps are identified by associativity of function composition. This includes identity coefficient maps and repeated fields. No identification of this integral predicate with an intrinsic or other integral presentation is part of the assertion.

proof.text: Use the ordinary realization lemma for each of $i,j,h$ and all their composites. Write $B_i$ for its exact ordinary module-sheaf scalar functor, $J_i$ for its restriction after deriving, $S_i$ for its raw rational localization and $c_i:S_i\simeq T_i$ for the specified normalized completion comparison. All these objects use the older predicate, on arbitrary $Y$. Completed coefficient maps respect composition: after each finite quotient projection both maps are induced by the same composite of valuation-ring maps; the defining limit therefore makes them equal. This also applies to identity maps.

proof.text: The ordinary scalar comparisons of the system-scalar lemma give $b_{j,i}:B_jB_i\simeq B_{ji}$ with $v\otimes(u\otimes x)\mapsto v\widehat j(u)\otimes x$. Their inverses send $w\otimes x$ to $w\otimes(1\otimes x)$: the displayed forward formula takes the latter to $w\otimes x$, so the inverse equations force this value. Compare the inverse paths of the ordinary pentagon. Both send $w\otimes x$ to $w\otimes(1\otimes(1\otimes x))$. This determines the maps: linearity reduces $w\otimes x$ to $1\otimes x$, additivity covers sums in the presheaf tensor, and the universal property of its sheafification extends equality uniquely to sheaf morphisms. Thus $B_h(b_{j,i});b_{h,ji}=b_{h,j}B_i;b_{hj,i}$, including repeated fields.

proof.text: Apply exact derived transformation pasting to the four abelian module-sheaf categories and the six exact ordinary scalar functors from step 1. Its hypothesis is precisely the equality of composites and whiskerings established in step 2. The induced comparisons are the inverse exact-derived compositor followed by the derived ordinary $b$, hence exactly integralOrdinaryDerivedScalarComp. Consequently their pentagon holds on every object of the unbounded derived category. Restrict to $\mathcal A_E^{\rm old}$: step 1 ensures every intermediate object lies in the required older subcategory. The restricted associators are integralConstructibleScalarComp, whose hom and inverse are the same ambient derived arrows. The full-subcategory inclusion is faithful by definition, so its equality of ambient arrows is the equality of these integral arrows.

proof.text: Let $A_{j,i}$ be rationalOrdinaryScalarComp. By its defining component formula it is the restricted integral associator tensored with $1$. Every raw object is an integral object, and $S_h(f\otimes1)=J_h(f)\otimes1$ by the ordinary realization lemma. In the raw Hom localization, $(f\otimes1);(g\otimes1)=(f;g)\otimes1$ by bilinear composition. Tensoring the integral equality of step 3 with $1$ therefore gives $S_h(A_{j,i,K});A_{h,ji,K}=A_{h,j,S_iK};A_{hj,i,K}$ at every raw object. This uses preservation of equality by localization, not faithfulness of localization.

proof.text:
Expand the definition of rationalConstructibleScalarComp. With composition in the written order it gives, for every pair of maps $u,v$,
$$a_{v,u,K}=c_{v,T_uK}^{-1};S_v(c_{u,K}^{-1});A_{v,u,K};c_{vu,K}.$$
Here $A$ is the localized restricted ordinary derived associator from step 4, and the $c$ are exactly those of step 1. This is the four-factor component formula for whiskering and composing the natural isomorphisms in the definition, so it introduces no new choice of comparison. Identify $(hj)i=h(ji)$ by associativity of the algebra-map functions.

source.place: Step (4), tensor associativity and its pentagon; retained legacy ScalarExtensionComposition construction

proof.text:
Put $P=c_{h,T_jT_iK}^{-1};S_h(c_{j,T_iK}^{-1});S_hS_j(c_{i,K}^{-1})$. Substitute step 5 in the left pentagon path. Naturality of $c_h$ moves $T_h(a_{j,i,K})$ across $c_h^{-1}$; cancel the adjacent $c_hc_h^{-1}$ and $S_h(c_{ji})S_h(c_{ji}^{-1})$. The result is $P;S_h(A_{j,i,K});A_{h,ji,K};c_{hji,K}$. In the right path the adjacent $c_{hj,T_iK}c_{hj,T_iK}^{-1}$ cancel. Naturality of $A_{h,j}$ at $c_{i,K}^{-1}:T_iK\to S_iK$ says
$$A_{h,j,T_iK};S_{hj}(c_{i,K}^{-1})=S_hS_j(c_{i,K}^{-1});A_{h,j,S_iK}.$$
The expanded right path is therefore $P;A_{h,j,S_iK};A_{hj,i,K};c_{hji,K}$. Step 4 equates the two middle factors. These equalities use only functoriality, naturality and inverse equations. They impose no distinctness of the fields and remain valid for identity maps, zero objects and the empty scheme.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalConstructibleScalar_coherence :
    (∀ K : rationalConstructibleCategory D l hl E Y,
      (rationalConstructibleScalarComp l E E (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E) Y L ι D hl).hom.app K =
        (rationalScalarExtension D l hl E Y L ι).map
          ((rationalConstructibleScalarUnit l E Y D hl).hom.app K)) ∧
    (∀ K : rationalConstructibleCategory D l hl E Y,
      (rationalConstructibleScalarComp l E L ι Y L (AlgHom.id (Padic l) L) D hl).hom.app K =
        (rationalConstructibleScalarUnit l L Y D hl).hom.app
          ((rationalScalarExtension D l hl E Y L ι).obj K)) ∧
    (∀ (N : Type u) [Field N] [Algebra (Padic l) N] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) N]
      (k : M →ₐ[Padic l] N) (K : rationalConstructibleCategory D l hl E Y),
      (rationalScalarExtension D l hl M Y N k).map
          ((rationalConstructibleScalarComp l E L ι Y M j D hl).hom.app K) ≫
        (rationalConstructibleScalarComp l E M (j.comp ι) Y N k D hl).hom.app K =
      (rationalConstructibleScalarComp l L M j Y N k D hl).hom.app
          ((rationalScalarExtension D l hl E Y L ι).obj K) ≫
        (rationalConstructibleScalarComp l E L ι Y N (k.comp j) D hl).hom.app K)
lean.note: The exact asserted pentagon is the third conjunct: (rationalConstructibleScalar_coherence l E L i Y M j D hl).2.2 N h K. The first two conjuncts are the separately packaged unit equations. This reuses exactly rationalConstructibleCategory, rationalScalarExtension and rationalConstructibleScalarComp on the specified older integral predicate, before transport to named composite coefficient maps. It asserts no identification with the intrinsic sfIntegralConstructibleCategory or sfRationalConstructibleCategory. No module or declaration is added.
